preview: A unified, customizable calculator dashboard that combines finance, health, fitness, and scientific calculators into a single web app. The interface uses the site’s celestial dark theme with constellation‑inspired icons, allowing users to switch between calculator types via a radial menu. Each calculator retains full functionality while sharing a consistent look and feel.

An interactive web quiz series that presents astronomy questions as “orbit challenges.” Users select from multiple‑choice answers that appear as orbiting planets or stars; each correct answer reveals a snippet of celestial lore (myth, history, or fun fact). The quiz can be themed around constellations, phases, or missions, encouraging repeated play.

A daily horoscope widget that combines zodiac forecasts with the celestial almanac aesthetic. Using an API that returns horoscope data for all 12 signs, the widget displays a stylized constellation‑themed panel showing the user's sign, today's planetary positions, and a concise prediction. It can be embedded on any page and offers a ‘Generate Your Personal Horoscope’ button that creates a custom PNG with the user's sign symbol and a horoscope excerpt.

A lightweight visualization tool that displays the current lunar phase and provides a calendar of upcoming phases (new moon, first quarter, full moon, last quarter). Users can enter their birth date to see the moon phase on that day, linking it to personal astrology. The UI uses a dark, constellation‑styled backdrop with subtle glow effects.

A visualization tool that maps the positions of the planets in real time and highlights when any two or more planets are in alignment. The interface displays a 2D ecliptic chart with planet icons moving along their orbits, and a list of upcoming alignments with dates. Users can subscribe to receive notifications for notable alignments that match the celestial theme of the site.

An interactive love‑compatibility calculator that takes two users' birth dates (or chosen zodiac signs) and analyzes their astrological synastric chart to produce a compatibility score. The result includes a visual “galaxy‑entwined” scorecard, a breakdown of dominant aspects (e.g., trine, square), and a short narrative describing how the two personalities interact in love, friendship, and communication, all framed within the celestial almanac aesthetic.

A celestial‑themed baby name generator that suggests names inspired by constellations, stars, planets, and mythological figures from astronomy. Users can filter results by gender or name length, and each suggested name includes a brief astrophysical backstory (e.g., “Lyra” from the harp constellation). The generated name list can be saved as a PDF or shared directly from the site.

A tip calculator that also splits the total bill among friends, showing each person's share including tax and tip. The UI uses a sleek dark background with subtle starfield animation, allowing users to input the total amount, tip percentage, tax, and number of people. The result displays per‑person cost and a friendly “You owe” message with a tiny constellation icon representing their share.

A minimalist BMI calculator that takes height and weight (metric or imperial) and returns the BMI value along with the standard category (underweight, normal, overweight, obese). The UI features a star‑field background and a quick visual gauge (e.g., a circular progress bar) to indicate where the value falls, reinforcing the celestial aesthetic.

A precise loan calculator that computes monthly repayments, total interest, and amortization schedule for personal, auto, or mortgage loans. Input fields include loan amount, annual interest rate, and term (years or months). The output shows the monthly payment, total interest paid, and a downloadable amortization table. The design uses a deep‑space background with subtle orbital motion, reinforcing the site’s celestial theme.
